name: Cervical Isometric Extension
steps: Sit or stand tall with your spine erect and shoulders comfortably pulled back.
Clasp your hands together and place your palms against the back of your head (occiput).
Gently press the back of your head backward into your hands as if looking up.
Match the pressure with your hands so that no actual movement occurs.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5 to 10 seconds with steady breathing.
Gradually release the contraction and repeat.
coaching_cues: Do not tilt your head back; maintain a level chin and neutral gaze.
Apply smooth, gentle pressure without yanking.
Keep your chest open and upright.
